messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGED on-call: multiple model load failures in prod-us-west-2. Alert summary: a spike of model-load OOMs + 'compile timeout' errors correlating with deploy at ~now - 3m. Severity: P1. Affected service: inference-serving (runtime cluster: us-west-2-prod). Pager: @EVA (oncall). Logs attached below.

EVA (oncall): I'm on it. Jumping into the runtime dashboards and the node pool. Can someone paste the most recent deploy id?

Alice M: deploy id is `deploy-20270320-0930` — that was the candidate bundle that added the new LLAMA-quantized-xt-13b build artifact.

Ben R: seeing repeated container crashes during model load: `OOM at load` and `CUDA out of memory` in the same nodes. A few nodes also show `nvrtc compile timeout`.

Carmen L: quick dump from one of the failed pods (exec logs):

```
[2027-03-20T09:32:17Z] ERROR runtime::loader - failed to deserialize model weights: unexpected EOF while reading tensor buffer
[2027-03-20T09:32:18Z] INFO runtime::loader - attempting fallback to quantized shard
[2027-03-20T09:32:20Z] DEBUG cuda - launching kernel compile, timeout=120s
[2027-03-20T09:34:21Z] ERROR cuda - nvrtc timed out after 120000ms
[2027-03-20T09:34:22Z] ERROR runtime::loader - GPU OOM while allocating KV cache  (requested=14.3GB, available=10.8GB)
[2027-03-20T09:34:22Z] FATAL agent - container crash (exit code 137)
```

Dmitri K: those numbers align — looks like the new bundle increased peak memory at load by ~4GB due to a dense attention patch plus larger optimizer tensors for warmup. Also seeing some nodes with fragmented GPU memory from prior jobs (node flaps earlier this morning).

EVA (oncall): immediate mitigations: 1) take the problematic variant out of routing (route around `llama-xt-13b:v2`) 2) scale workers to spare capacity in us-east-1 3) disable warmup compilation on new instances to avoid nvrtc timeouts. Doing (1) now.

InfraBot: routing-change: `llama-xt-13b:v2` removed from prod-us-west-2 pool (applied to router-rack-5).

Ben R: after removing the variant, error rate dropped but we still see instance restarts for a small subset — likely failed loads persisted on already-scheduled pods. Recommend cordoning the affected nodes and force-recreate pods.

EVA (oncall): cordon + drain on node `gpunode-uw2-17` initiated.

Alice M: I'm seeing a pattern: deserialization fails when a shard's checksum mismatch occurs (we have a partial upload for shard 3 from the new bundle). That would explain unexpected EOF. If we retry load it'll OOM because fallback tries to allocate full KV and hits GPU memory limits.

Carmen L: can we switch those requests to a smaller quantized variant `llama-xt-mini` as a graceful degradation? That would reduce per-token quality but restore customer throughput.

EVA (oncall): yes — initiating automatic fallback policy to `llama-xt-mini:stable` for 100% of traffic for affected routes.

InfraBot: policy update applied: route policy `fallback-for-load-failure` -> target `llama-xt-mini:stable` (force=true).

Support Bot: customer-impact estimate: 23 customers affected; 6 on high-traffic endpoints experienced 5xxs, others saw increased latency. Notifying SRE-on-call and account-owners for the 6 customers.

Ben R: manual mitigation checklist I'm running:
- rotate the model bundle to last-known-good (LLAMA-xt-13b:v1)
- remove broken shards from artifact store and re-upload verified shards
- raise `load_timeout_ms` to 300000 temporarily to give nvrtc more headroom while we investigate
- disable auto-compile on task assignment for the problematic nodes

Dmitri K: caution on increasing load_timeout — if a node gets stuck it'll hold a GPU longer and reduce concurrency. For now, prefer to increase only on a small canary subset.

EVA (oncall): agreeing. I'll bump `load_timeout_ms` to 180000 for canary pool only and schedule a controlled rollback to v1 for the rest. Rolling rollback now via deploy rollback job.

Alice M: rollback job kicked off: `kubectl -n serving set image deploy/inference-router inference=redwood/inference:llama-xt-13b-v1` (running as job `rollback-1790123456`).

Carmen L: meanwhile I've started re-upload of shards with verified checksums to the artifact store (s3://redwood-models/llama-xt-13b/v2/). I'll validate checksums and mark the bundle as quarantined until verification completes.

EVA (oncall): good. Next: we need a clear runbook note for on-call handoff at the 30-minute mark. Ben, do you want to take the handoff once you finish the artifact validation?

Ben R: can do. I'll summarize state for handoff:
- root cause (hypothesis): partial artifact upload + increased memory footprint -> deserialization EOF + fallback allocation -> GPU OOM -> container crashes.
- mitigations applied: routing removal for v2, fallback to `llama-xt-mini`, node cordon/drain, rollback to v1, canary `load_timeout_ms=180000`, shard reupload in progress.
- customer impact: 23 customers affected, 6 severe; tickets created: INC-45912, INC-45913, INC-45914.
- next steps: validate re-uploaded shards, redeploy v2 to a canary with extra memory reservation and no auto-compile, run end-to-end load test, then reintroduce gradually.

EVA (oncall): handing off to Ben R for the next shift. Ben, please make a Slack summary and call out any postmortem actions you want captured. I'll go mark the incident as ongoing and notify pager rotation.

Ben R: thanks — summary below for handoff. Will keep the incident state and open postmortem issue.

```
Handoff summary (from Ben R @1790125200):
- Status: mitigated (traffic routed away from v2, most customer traffic served by fallback). Some pods still being reconciled.
- Action items for postmortem:
  1) Add artifact upload checksum validation + atomic publish for model bundles.
  2) Add pre-load canary that attempts a dry-run deserialize on CPU first to catch EOFs.
  3) Improve runtime memory accounting at model-load to reserve KV cache before heavy allocations.
  4) Add config to skip NVRTC compile on cold-start for large models and prefer precompiled kernels.
  5) Update deploy playbook to include immediate rollback path if load OOM rate > 0.5% within 5m of deploy.
- Customer comms: CS to send targeted emails to the 6 high-impact customers; use status page update for general notice.
```

EVA (oncall): marked. I'm closing my active handoff now. @incident-bot please escalate to Postmortem queue and link to job `rollback-1790123456`.

incident-bot: Incident INC-45915 created; severity=P1; linked jobs: rollback-1790123456; assignee: Ben R; postmortem-queue: added.

Ben R: taking over. I'll follow up with a short postmortem draft in #postmortems and assign owners for action items. If anyone else sees residual OOMs or other anomalies, ping me directly. :thumbsup:

Carmen L: I'll finish the shard verification and ping once v2 is cleared for a controlled canary later today.

Dmitri K: logging note — we should correlate GPU fragmentation traces from earlier node flaps (0400-0500 UTC) into the postmortem; may be a contributing factor.

EVA (oncall): thanks team. Handing off complete.

[end of thread]
